About Us
# We started Hilario because great products deserve better marketing.

Our Story
Hilario was built for B2B SaaS companies that have outgrown their current marketing but are not ready for a full in-house team. We have worked with founders, sales leaders, and operators across Canada and the United States, helping them build the positioning, content, and sales materials that close more deals.

The Team

![Image 1: Hamed Jafari](https://www.hilariocreative.com/assets/hamed-jafari-headshot-_57igni4.avif)

Hamed Jafari

Partner and Marketing Strategist

Hamed has spent over a decade working with tech founders and operators across North America and internationally. He co-founded TechRasa, a leading startup media and market research company, where he interviewed dozens of founders, worked closely with their teams, and built a deep understanding of how fast-growing companies tell their story, find their market, and scale.

That experience—sitting inside many companies and understanding their buyers, their positioning, and their gaps—is the foundation of how Hilario works.

Hamed’s work has been featured in Forbes, Bloomberg, HuffPost, PBS, and PRI.

* * *

![Image 2: Zeynab Abdolghaffari](https://www.hilariocreative.com/assets/zeynab-abdolghaffari-headshot-BhlXskD1.avif)

Zeynab Abdolghaffari

Partner and Creative Director

Zeynab has led design for tech companies across North America, building visual identities and creative systems that work across digital and print. She brings structure and consistency to every engagement, from brand assets to sales collateral to web design.

Because Zeynab works alongside the marketing strategy from day one, what your buyers see is always consistent. The website, the deck, and the LinkedIn post all tell the same story.
